Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was stopped at a red light on eastbound Highway 6 in Sugar Land, Texas, when the rear of the vehicle was
struck by a sedan operated by Driver 2. Driver 1 was the only occupant of the front seat, with a Passenger seated in
the rear, and both were identified at the scene. Driver 1 reported neck strain and was evaluated by responding
medical personnel, though it is not yet clear whether the reported injury resulted from this collision or from another
cause. Driver 2 stated that the vehicle did not stop in time, and this account is consistent with the statements of two
independent witnesses who were present at the intersection and with photographs taken at the scene. The rear
bumper and trunk area of Driver 1's vehicle show damage that matches the described impact, and no earlier damage
to the vehicle was observed or reported. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the policy covering the vehicle.
Officers noted no signs of impairment and issued a citation to Driver 2 for failure to control speed. Follow-up with
medical proivders is recommended to determine the source of the reported symptoms.
